items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I think he wrote 'Old Fashioned Love'... you know who you should ask that of? Erroll Garner Earl Gunner.

ctx.x: I think he wrote "Old Fashioned Love" or, maybe J.P. Johnson. I don't think Mel Stizel. No. I don't think so. But gee, when you say, how does one learn

to improvise ... you know who you should ask that of? Erroll Garner Earl Gunner. And you know why I say that, don't you? He hadn't had any formal training. He doesn't read music. He just sits down and plays what, you know, what comes to him. Now how do you -- go ahead.
